subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel accept a new `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` env contract with a hostname default, or should instance identity wait for the approved resource-identity design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071?
rationale: The code change is small, but the permanent telemetry identity source affects operator contracts, privacy expectations, and compatibility with standard OpenTelemetry resource configuration.

options.title: Align With Canonical Identity Design
options.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement `service.instance.id` through the standard resource path or a maintainer-approved bounded OpenClaw identity seam.

options.title: Adopt The New Env Contract
options.body: Accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` intentionally, but require docs, precedence rules, privacy guidance, upgrade expectations, and real export proof before merge.

options.title: Pause Or Close In Favor Of The Issue
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged until the canonical issue decides the durable identity source, or close it if that design moves in a different direction.

recommendation.title: Align With Canonical Identity Design
recommendation.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement `service.instance.id` through the standard resource path or a maintainer-approved bounded OpenClaw identity seam.

likelyOwner.reason: Bek owns the canonical identity issue and has adjacent diagnostics-otel implementation history, so they are the best available routing candidate for the product decision.
